about: Zoloft (sertraline) 50 mg is supplied monthly for 17 months; the record says treatment started in March 2023 (more than 2 years), three depressive episodes with impaired daily function in the last 5 years, and full remission.

Sertraline is supplied with recurrent episodes and full remission on record, but the record says the current treatment started in February 2026, so it is under 2 years and must not flag.
